positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineered the back-end of a prescription digital therapeutic software, with a focus in decomposing existing monolithic repositories into microservices
• Operated within a sprint framework to maintain existing APIs and create new APIs that were used  throughout the company
• Created a new document-generation pipeline that streamlined the software release process in collaboration with a team of engineers
• Conducted functional specification reviews and code reviews of team members' projects and fixes
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · Microservices · JavaScript · REST APIs · TypeScript · Node.js · SQL · GitHub · Gitlab · Harness · Docker · Agile Methodologies · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Executed projects through their lifecycle, including project inception, requirements definition, systems design, writing and documenting code, testing plans, performance testing, and unit testing
• Ensured electronic medical records software was compliant with healthcare, government, and business requirements
• Corrected errors and improved the integrity of electronic medical records through software enhancements while working within a scrum framework
• Reviewed the technical design of team members' projects and fixes
• Coordinated team-building exercises and social events to enhance team culture during the pandemic
positions.insights: Skills: C# · TypeScript · Relational Databases · .NET Framework · Agile Methodologies · React.js · Unit Testing

positions.title: Library Aide
positions.description:
•	Assisted patrons in media (DVD, CD, microfilm, microfiche) retrieval 
•	Managed rooms for scheduled public and private viewing of media

positions.title: Control System Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a new, custom Linux image to install on virtual machines that housed Class A, human-rated, safety-critical spaceflight command and control systems
• Communicated with project manager through detailed project reports and regular milestone updates
• Lead STEM activities for a NASA outreach event involving area youth

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
•	Performed hardware and software calibrations for Micro-X rocket (launched July 2018) 
•	Analyzed data from experiments testing various components prior to launch 
•	Managed ongoing projects including CAD development using SolidWorks
•	Worked with and constructed wiring systems and electrical circuit boards

company.name: Northwestern University Figueroa Research Group in Experimental Astroparticle Physics

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
•	Conducted research on galaxy formation, evolution, and binary neutron star systems using computer simulations                      
•	Generated and analyzed data using Northwestern’s Quest Supercomputer
•	Presented results from summer research to faculty and designed website to share findings
•	Attended computer programming tutorials in Python and Unix commands

positions.title: Technology Maintenance Crew Member
positions.description:
•	Instructed team to reimage computers with new operating system
•	Maintained and cleaned computers, projectors, and other miscellaneous technology in school district
